item.tib: dbal phur nag po gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: zhes pa'i dbal phur nag po'i bon/ rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid/ 'og min gyi gnas nas/ dbyings kyi ston pa mkha' 'gying kha'i thugs bcud/ yum chen thugs rje byams ma nas/ sprul pa'i sku ston pa gshen rabs mi bo la brgyud de / ston pa'i thugs kyi klong nas yid kyi cho 'phrul du gdul dka' 'dul bye+ed sprul pa'i dbal bon stag la me 'bar du sku sprul nas/ 'gro ba log par rtog pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du/ srid pa'i dbal ri zur gsum zla gam gting ring brag phug tu/ sgrub thabs rgyal po dbal gyi phur nag bsgrabs shing / shin tu gdul dka' ba'i sems can bdud dang srin po bgegs la sogs/ phyin ci log tu gol ba rnams/ dgongs spyod khyad par can gyis btul zhing bsgral te/ yang dag pa'i sa la 'god par mdzad/ de ltar bdag gzhan las dang nyon mongs sgrol ba'i phrin las zab mo 'di yi/ lung dang man ngag ma nub par/ phyi rabs bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag ste/ dbal bon kha yal me 'bar la sogs rgyud 'dzin dbal bon bco brgyad la rim bzhin brgyud nas bsgrubs te grub pa'i rtags bstan nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ mkhas pa de rnams kyi yang bcud thugs kyi brnag pa/ bod yul gyis (gyi) dbus su mkhas shing rig pa che ba bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud do/ bar der dus dang sems can gyis las 'phro zhan pas/ bod yul ru bzhi dbus kyi sa skor du/ bon gyi bstan pa 'phel grib gyur pa'i skabs su/ bla chen dran pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa dbal gyi phur pa nag po 'di la/ bka' gter gnyis dang*/ sde snod don gsum la sogs pa phyes nas/ gter ni bla yi pho brang bse sgo can dang/ pho brang dbus kyi yang rtse dang / 'gran bzang gi gtsug lag khang rnams su sbas/ bka' ni bla chen dran pa'i thugs la sbas pa/ dag pa'i zhing dang mkha' spyod kyi gnas rnams rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams kyis ma nub par spyod do/ phyis dus sems can gyi las 'phro bzang ba dang / g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i dus babs tshe/ bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can/ sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pa'i/ sa mo phag gi lor/ dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad la/ dag snang nyams kyi snang char/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i grogs mdzad de/ zhang zhung gis (gi) yul g.yung drung gtams pa'i gsang phug tu phyin nas/ bla chen dran pa la sogs zhang bod rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yis/ gsang spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ zhi khro phur pa'i dbang chen bskur/ khyad par dbal gyi phur nag gi rgyud lung man ngag bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par snyan rgyud thob pa'o// bkra shis dge legs bon bstan 'phel rgyas shog/
